product_description: Round cutting and grinding discs, manufactured from agglomerated synthetic abrasives, bonded with phenolic resin and reinforced with glass fibers. The abrasives consist primarily of aluminum oxide (corundum). The discs have a diameter ranging from 115 to 230 mm and a bore of 22.2 to 25.4 mm. The thickness of the discs varies from 1 to 6.3 mm. They are used for grinding and cutting various metals using electrically or non-electrically powered (hand) tools.

A synthetic preparation containing no petroleum or oil from bituminous minerals, offered in the form of an aqueous solution in packaging of 1 l, 5 l, or 25 l. The sprayable product is specially suitable for preventing the adhesion of welding spatter to metal workpieces, so that it does not need to be chipped off or ground away after welding. The preparation has a long-lasting anti-stick effect, is non-toxic, non-explosive, non-flammable, and non-carcinogenic. The preparation is also rust- and corrosion-resistant. It improves welded joints and weld seams.

According to the information provided, this is a four-wheeled electric wheelchair for people with limited mobility. The wheelchair has adjustable armrests (armrests), which can be easily folded out and made comfortable to sit on, and it also includes a cane holder. The wheelchair is equipped with a separate adjustable (folding) steering column, on which the control panel is located and the basket is also attached. It is equipped with a reverse gear and when the electric drive is turned off, the wheelchair can also be pushed in front of you. It can be folded to facilitate transport. Technical parameters: — engine power: 350 W; — battery: Lithium 36 V 12 Ah; — charger: 40 V 2 A; — load capacity: 120 kg; — dimensions: 99 x 55 x 85 cm; — tire size: front 9", rear 10"; — max. speed: 10 km/h; — range: 40 km; — brake: electromagnetic; — angle of climb: 15°; — display: LED.

According to the declared data, this is a treat for dogs; a chewy treat in the shape of small sticks (a white stick base made of beef hide wrapped in dried chicken meat). The product is intended for direct consumption by animals as a reward or treat (not intended for human consumption). Ingredients: chicken meat 65%, beef hide 30%, rice starch 5% (serves as a technological binder for fixing the meat layer to the rawhide base). The product contains less than 10% by weight of starch, but does not contain any dairy products. The finished products are packaged for retail sale, packed in plastic bags and then placed in cartons intended for distribution.

Applicant's specifications: Filling hose for AdBlue/urea (AUS32), 1 m - ideally suited for refilling urea additives; enables clean refilling, no contamination or unpleasant odors in the interior - suitable for 5-liter and 10-liter canisters. Findings on a sample: A hose was submitted consisting of a transparent, flexible inner hose made of plastic with a matching funnel-shaped adapter (with filter function) and a black, grooved outer hose made of plastic, fitted with plastic connectors on both ends. The inner hose has a diameter of approximately 0.8 cm and the outer hose has a diameter of approximately 2.0 cm. It is assumed that the hose cannot withstand a pressure of 27.6 MPa or more. Conclusion: This is a different type of plastic hose, neither reinforced with nor combined with other materials, with fittings, closures, or connectors.

The product described as a "chrome-plated frame base" is made of chrome-plated aluminum and measures 40 x 342 x 460 mm (W x H x D). It essentially consists of a long base rail with a rib projecting upwards from each end. The upper end of the base is attached to a vanity unit using screws and the included mounting hardware. The frame base is a necessary and identifiable component of vanity units of the type used in bathrooms, ensuring the unit's stability at the appropriate height.

Refined copper foil. The goods are a foil of refined copper (99.9%) with a thickness of 0.012 mm to 0.14 mm, which is cut to approximately 580 mm x 650 mm or traded on rolls. The goods are used for electronic applications.

The product described as "L Pen Ballpoint Pen" is a ballpoint pen with a non-replaceable refill and paste-like writing ink. The writing instrument is approximately 17.2 cm long and consists essentially of a two-tone (pink at the bottom, black at the top) plastic casing with a printed company logo on the side, a stylized pink plastic hand with outstretched thumb and forefinger attached to a spring, and a refill with a metal ball at the writing tip.

Applicant's information: Polymer mixture of various copolymers. A sample was not submitted. Confidential information on the composition of the granules was available. According to this information, alpha-methylstyrene predominates by weight among the monomers. Finding: Other plastic within the meaning of Note 3 to Chapter 39, not elsewhere specified or included, in primary form.

Applicant's description: GMP ("Good Manufacturing Practice") compliant, xeno- and serum-free culture medium for the maintenance and propagation of undifferentiated human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) under feeder-free conditions. The product is in the form of a liquid nutrient solution to support both automated and manual workflows. Description: Prepared nutrient substrates for the cultivation and maintenance of microorganisms (including viruses and the like) or plant, human, or animal cells.

Boron trifluoride enriched with boron-11 isotope. The product is characterized as a colorless gas. According to the information provided, it is chemically homogeneous boron trifluoride with a purity of more than 99.99% by weight, enriched with the boron isotope 11B to a content of more than 99.9% at. The product is registered as a chemical under CAS number 20654-88-0. According to the information provided, it is used for semiconductor manufacturing.

Connector, essentially consisting of a plastic housing with four internal metal contact pins on one side and the corresponding number of angled protruding contact pins for printed circuit board mounting on the opposite side, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, for establishing an electrical connection by inserting a corresponding mating part after mounting (soldering) on ​​a printed circuit board. Attachment: 1 Figure

The goods described as a "garden seating set" are a set presented for individual sale, consisting essentially of: - a wooden bench; 113 x 75 x 77 cm (L x W x H), - two wooden chairs; 50 x 75 x 77 cm (L x W x H), and - a wooden table; 110 x 52 x 45 cm (L x W x H). The seating is equipped with custom-fit, loose seat and back cushions and is available in cream and anthracite. A dining table is not included due to the low height. The nature of the set is determined by the number and intended use of the seating. The products are designed to be placed on the ground and are suitable for furnishing, for example, patios. Attachment: an illustration

So-called universal safety plug, consisting of a specifically shaped plastic housing with a removable plastic cap, a plug on one side and a cable connection on the opposite side, and an integrated, replaceable fuse, for a voltage of 12 V, for automotive cigarette lighters (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), for making an electrical connection after the assembly of a cable by inserting a corresponding mating contact (characteristic main activity of the combined machine) and for protecting electrical circuits or connected loads. Annex: 1 Figure

A so-called mobile residual oil measuring device, presented as a retail package, essentially consisting of a measuring device whose characteristics are defined by its use, permanently installed in a specially manufactured plastic case, a power supply, a PTFE connecting hose (Ø 6 mm), an instruction manual, a calibration certificate, and a USB flash drive (all components are located in the case). The measuring device, which is operated with the case open, essentially consists of a stainless steel housing (282 x 168 x 139.7 mm) with a sample gas inlet, sample gas outlet, a touchscreen, status LEDs, a dosing chamber, a measuring chamber, a vacuum diaphragm pump, a pressure sensor, a PID sensor, a humidity sensor (for internal measurements), a power supply input, a Modbus RTU via an RS485 interface, an analog output, and other electrical, electronic, and optical components. It serves for the early detection of potential contamination in compressed air systems. For this purpose, a partial flow of compressed air is extracted from the system and directed to the PID sensor. Hydrocarbons are ionized by a special UV lamp, generating an ion current proportional to the concentration of ionized molecules. This current is amplified and converted into electronic and voltage signals. Measurement results (measuring range: 0.001 to 5.000 mg/m³) are displayed, stored internally, and can be output in both analog and digital formats.

The goods described as a "wall-mounted boot rack" are a piece of wooden furniture measuring 73 x 50 x 15 cm (L x H x D). They consist essentially of two L-shaped wooden profiles with holes or fixings for wall mounting, and between them two parallel wooden slats, each with ten 15 cm long, rounded rungs running diagonally upwards. The goods are intended for storing items such as boots (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision) in kindergartens or schools.

Sheet of non-alloy steel. According to the information provided, the goods are a flat product of non-alloy steel (Q235). The sheet has a length of 3140 mm, a width of 150 mm, and a thickness of 6 mm. It was produced by hot rolling and cutting. The goods are used, according to the information provided, as cutting guides (burning table strips) in plasma and oxy-fuel cutting systems.

Applicant's description: So-called teat liner (rubber or soft rubber), consisting of a dimensionally accurate, specifically shaped, flexible rubber tube manufactured according to a drawing, with a total length of approximately 300–340 mm and an outer diameter of approximately 50–62 mm, as well as an integrated head for attachment and sealing in the teat cup and a milk hose section (straight or angled), for use as a teat liner after installation in the teat cup of a milking machine. No product sample was submitted. The product was illustrated by photographs and technical drawings. These show that it is a tapered product with an integrated attachment and sealing head. Finding: This is a different product made of soft rubber.

Applicant's information: This is a connector, fitting, or nozzle that is installed in a foot brake module. The connector consists of a housing, a guide sleeve, and a locking ring, all made of plastic; it also includes a soft rubber O-ring, a clamping ring, and a metal star washer. The connector is used to connect an air hose to the foot brake module. No sample was submitted. The plastic connector was illustrated by a technical drawing and product information. Finding: This is a connector (made of plastic) for pipes and hoses.

Feed charcoal for dogs and cats - charcoal produced from the carbonization of freshly harvested wood chips (according to the applicant) under anaerobic conditions, in granular form (particle size: < 3 mm), - packaged in 500 g or 2 kg bags, - for use as feed charcoal for dogs and cats. "Charcoal, not from bamboo, not from shells or nuts, not exported from Somalia"

The product described as a "3-in-1 Bamboo Toilet Brush Set" is a composite product, essentially consisting of a toilet brush and a piece of furniture (comprising a stand and a shelf). The product consists primarily of a base plate made of plastic-coated cement, from which a powder-coated steel pole extends upwards. At the top of the pole is a bamboo holder for smartphones, and below this is a small bamboo holder with an enlarged, rounded end for toilet paper. The set also includes a plastic container attached to the base plate, which serves to hold the toilet brush. The toilet brush has a plastic ferrule and bristles, as well as a bamboo handle. The furniture and the toilet brush constitute a composite product, the nature of which is determined by the furniture's importance for its intended use. The furniture is designed to be placed on the floor. It is a piece of furniture made of various materials (metal, wood, plastic, and cement), but no single material is identifiable as having a defining characteristic. There is no indication of handwork. Attachment: an illustration

Application details (assumed to be correct): Fruit and vegetable juice mixture with fruit puree, ginger juice and wheat germ oil, presented for retail sale (500 ml bottle with screw cap). Alcohol: not included. Products or fats from products of headings 0401 to 0404: not included. Sucrose or invert sugar: included. Non-alcoholic beverage, other than those specified in UOS codes 2202 1000 to 2202 9915 of the CN, containing sugar (sucrose or invert sugar), other.

Strawberry fruit powder with maltodextrin. According to the application, the product is a fruit powder consisting of strawberry pulp and maltodextrin, obtained by spray drying. It is used in the production of ice cream. Glucose or starch (according to the application): more than 5% by weight; food preparation not elsewhere specified or included, not belonging to subheadings 2106 1020 to 2106 9059 of the Combined Nomenclature (CN), containing more than 5% by weight of glucose or starch; due to the predominant maltodextrin content, not a fruit preparation of heading 2008 of the CN.

The product is a component approximately 41 x 40 x 20 mm (L x W x D) manufactured according to a technical drawing from a copper-zinc casting alloy. The component has an internal thread and functions as a spindle nut for supporting and guiding a spindle. It is part of an operating table and is installed in the leg plates.

Applicant's information: Christmas tree ornament tins made of tinplate in three designs. They contain three chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Findings on samples: Three approximately cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate (dimensions: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5 cm) filled with a light beige, firm cream, in the style of pralines; odor: of chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and milk cream. The pralines are individually wrapped in red metal foil (label: "milk cream"). The pralines are in a metal tin, which does not constitute packaging within the meaning of General Rule 5(b) (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29438/26-1). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines in the assortment. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other

Description: Cardboard packaging in the form of multicolored printed rabbit heads in two different designs, containing two small chocolate eggs, a bite-sized chocolate bar, and a bag of gummy bears. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: A colorfully printed, hexagonal cardboard folding box (motif: rabbit head), closed at the top with a green textile ribbon. The cardboard folding box contains a cellophane bag filled with the following confectionery: - a brown chocolate bar filled with a beige cream. The bar is sealed in colorfully printed plastic film, printed with (excerpt): "choco & cream". - two hollow chocolate eggs, individually wrapped in colorfully printed metal foil. - A rectangular, colorfully printed, sealed plastic bag containing 14 gummy bears in different colors (red, green, yellow, and white), length: approx. 2.5 cm, width: approx. 1.4 cm. Findings: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of bars, sticks, or tablets: filled.

Details: Transparent sanitary silicone; 1-component silicone-based sealant; for use in corner, movement, and connection joints in sanitary and kitchen areas, for window and glass sealing, for sealing seams of display cases and glass blocks, and for small-area bonding (e.g., window muntins); Packaging: 310 ml cartridge with screw-on dispensing nozzle.

According to the application, the item is a star-shaped decorative object measuring approximately 30 cm long x 30 cm high x 5 cm deep. The product consists of a basic framework of wooden slats, which is wrapped with flexible grapevine branches (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46) using a wickerwork technique. A textile hanging loop is attached to the top. The wickerwork, in terms of its extent and importance to the decorative effect, defines the character of this handmade product.

Recombinant antigens in solution. These products are biotechnologically (recombinantly) produced antigens (proteins) of human, microbial, or viral origin, expressed in suitable host cells and purified. The antigens are present in aqueous, frozen solutions. The antigens are usually traded in quantities of 1 mg, 5 mg, or 10 mg per package. The antigens are used for the manufacture of diagnostic immunological tests. They are not immunological products within the meaning of Note 2 to Chapter 30 of the CN.

According to the application and the submitted product information, the product is a set of goods packaged for retail sale (cardboard box), consisting of: - a thermally insulated, specifically shaped drainage system (so-called gully) made of polyurethane, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, - with a foamed-in connection sleeve of approximately 495 x 495 mm made of polyvinyl chloride, - integrated into an insulating body of approximately 1000 x 500 x 120 mm (L x W x H) made of polyurethane or mineral wool (depending on the model), - a flexible vapor barrier panel made of plastic, - stainless steel pipes with a total length of 2 to 4 m, - stainless steel connectors, retaining clamps, and pipe clamps, - various assembly and fastening materials, - paper assembly instructions. The disassembled product serves as a component in the construction of flat roofs for the flow-through drainage of roof surfaces and is incorporated into a flat roof structure for this purpose. Particularly with regard to its quantity and significance in relation to its use, the plastic determines the nature of the goods.
